verses.original: λέγω Ἀλήθειαν ἐν Χριστῷ οὐ ψεύδομαι συμμαρτυρούσης μοι μου τῆς συνειδήσεώς ἐν Ἁγίῳ Πνεύματι
verses.transliteration: legō Alētheian en Christō ou pseudomai symmartyrousēs moi mou tēs syneidēseōs en Hagiō Pneumati
verses.literal: I speak [the] truth in Christ vvv I am not lying as confirmed . . . by my - conscience in [the] Holy Spirit

verses.original: ὅτι μοί ἐστιν μεγάλη λύπη καὶ ἀδιάλειπτος ὀδύνη τῇ μου καρδίᾳ
verses.transliteration: hoti moi estin megalē lypē kai adialeiptos odynē tē mou kardia
verses.literal: - I have deep sorrow and unceasing anguish in my heart

verses.original: γὰρ ἐγὼ ηὐχόμην αὐτὸς εἶναι ἀνάθεμα ἀπὸ τοῦ Χριστοῦ ὑπὲρ μου τῶν ἀδελφῶν μου τῶν συγγενῶν κατὰ σάρκα
verses.transliteration: gar egō ēuchomēn autos einai anathema apo tou Christou hyper mou tōn adelphōn mou tōn syngenōn kata sarka
verses.literal: For I could wish that I myself were cursed [and] cut off from - Christ for the sake of my - brothers my - own flesh and blood . . . . . .

verses.original: οἵτινές εἰσιν Ἰσραηλῖται ὧν ἡ υἱοθεσία καὶ ἡ δόξα καὶ αἱ διαθῆκαι καὶ ἡ νομοθεσία καὶ ἡ λατρεία καὶ αἱ ἐπαγγελίαι
verses.transliteration: hoitines eisin Israēlitai hōn hē huiothesia kai hē doxa kai hai diathēkai kai hē nomothesia kai hē latreia kai hai epangeliai
verses.literal: [the people of] - Israel [Theirs is] the adoption as sons [theirs] the divine glory and the covenants [theirs] the giving of the law - the temple worship and the promises

verses.original: ὧν οἱ πατέρες καὶ ἐξ ὧν τὸ κατὰ σάρκα ὁ Χριστὸς ὁ ὢν Θεὸς ἐπὶ πάντων εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας εὐλογητὸς ἀμήν
verses.transliteration: hōn hoi pateres kai ex hōn to kata sarka ho Christos ho ōn Theos epi pantōn eis tous aiōnas eulogētos amēn
verses.literal: [Theirs are] the patriarchs and from them [ proceeds ] - vvv [the] human [descent] - of Christ who is God over all vvv vvv forever worthy of praise Amen

verses.original: δὲ Οὐχ οἷον ὅτι τοῦ Θεοῦ ὁ λόγος ἐκπέπτωκεν γὰρ οὐ πάντες οἱ ἐξ Ἰσραήλ οὗτοι Ἰσραήλ
verses.transliteration: de Ouch hoion hoti tou Theou ho logos ekpeptōken gar ou pantes hoi ex Israēl houtoi Israēl
verses.literal: - [It is] not as though - - God’s - word has failed For not all who [are] descended from Israel [are] Israel

verses.original: οὐδ’ ὅτι εἰσὶν Ἀβραάμ σπέρμα πάντες τέκνα ἀλλ’ Ἐν Ἰσαὰκ σοι σπέρμα κληθήσεταί
verses.transliteration: oud’ hoti eisin Abraam sperma pantes tekna all’ En Isaak soi sperma klēthēsetai
verses.literal: Nor because they are Abraham’s descendants [are] they all [his] children On the contrary Through Isaac your offspring will be reckoned

verses.original: τοῦτ’ ἔστιν οὐ τὰ τέκνα τῆς σαρκὸς ταῦτα τοῦ Θεοῦ τέκνα ἀλλὰ τὰ τέκνα τῆς ἐπαγγελίας λογίζεται εἰς σπέρμα
verses.transliteration: tout’ estin ou ta tekna tēs sarkos tauta tou Theou tekna alla ta tekna tēs epangelias logizetai eis sperma
verses.literal: So it is not the children of the flesh [who are] - God’s children but [it is] the children of the promise who are regarded as offspring

verses.original: γὰρ οὗτος ὁ ἐπαγγελίας λόγος Κατὰ τοῦτον τὸν καιρὸν ἐλεύσομαι καὶ τῇ Σάρρᾳ ἔσται υἱός
verses.transliteration: gar houtos ho epangelias logos Kata touton ton kairon eleusomai kai tē Sarra estai huios
verses.literal: For this [is] what [the] promise stated At - the appointed time I will return and - Sarah will have a son

verses.original: Οὐ μόνον δέ ἀλλὰ καὶ Ῥεβέκκα ἔχουσα κοίτην ἐξ ἑνὸς ἡμῶν τοῦ πατρὸς Ἰσαὰκ
verses.transliteration: Ou monon de alla kai Rhebekka echousa koitēn ex henos hēmōn tou patros Isaak
verses.literal: Not only that but - Rebecca’s [children] were conceived by one [man] our - father Isaac

verses.original: γὰρ μήπω γεννηθέντων μηδὲ πραξάντων τι ἀγαθὸν ἢ φαῦλον ἵνα ἡ τοῦ Θεοῦ πρόθεσις κατ’ ἐκλογὴν μένῃ
verses.transliteration: gar mēpō gennēthentōn mēde praxantōn ti agathon ē phaulon hina hē tou Theou prothesis kat’ eklogēn menē
verses.literal: Yet before [the twins] were born [or] had done anything good or bad in order that - - God’s plan of election might stand

verses.original: οὐκ ἐξ ἔργων ἀλλ’ ἐκ τοῦ καλοῦντος αὐτῇ ἐρρέθη ὅτι Ὁ μείζων δουλεύσει τῷ ἐλάσσονι
verses.transliteration: ouk ex ergōn all’ ek tou kalountos autē errethē hoti Ho meizōn douleusei tō elassoni
verses.literal: not by works but by Him who calls she was told - The older will serve the younger

verses.original: καθὼς γέγραπται Τὸν Ἰακὼβ ἠγάπησα δὲ τὸν Ἠσαῦ ἐμίσησα
verses.transliteration: kathōs gegraptai Ton Iakōb ēgapēsa de ton Ēsau emisēsa
verses.literal: So it is written - Jacob I loved but - Esau I hated

verses.original: Τί οὖν ἐροῦμεν μὴ παρὰ τῷ θεῷ ἀδικία μὴ γένοιτο
verses.transliteration: Ti oun eroumen mē para tō theō adikia mē genoito
verses.literal: What then shall we say [Is] - - God unjust vvv Certainly not

verses.original: γὰρ λέγει τῷ Μωϋσεῖ Ἐλεήσω ὃν ἂν ἐλεῶ καὶ οἰκτιρήσω ὃν ἂν οἰκτίρω
verses.transliteration: gar legei tō Mōusei Eleēsō hon an eleō kai oiktirēsō hon an oiktirō
verses.literal: For He says to Moses I will have mercy on whom vvv I have mercy and I will have compassion on whom vvv I have compassion

verses.original: Ἄρα οὖν οὐ τοῦ θέλοντος οὐδὲ τοῦ τρέχοντος ἀλλὰ τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐλεῶντος
verses.transliteration: Ara oun ou tou thelontos oude tou trechontos alla tou Theou eleōntos
verses.literal: So then [it does] not [depend] on man’s desire [or] - effort but on God’s mercy

verses.original: γὰρ ἡ γραφὴ λέγει τῷ Φαραὼ ὅτι ἐξήγειρά σε Εἰς αὐτὸ τοῦτο ὅπως ἐνδείξωμαι μου τὴν δύναμίν ἐν σοὶ καὶ ὅπως μου τὸ ὄνομά διαγγελῇ ἐν πάσῃ τῇ γῇ
verses.transliteration: gar hē graphē legei tō Pharaō hoti exēgeira se Eis auto touto hopōs endeixōmai mou tēn dynamin en soi kai hopōs mou to onoma diangelē en pasē tē gē
verses.literal: For the Scripture says to Pharaoh - I raised you up . . . for this very [purpose] that I might display My - power in you and that My - name might be proclaimed in all the earth

verses.original: ἄρα οὖν ἐλεεῖ ὃν θέλει δὲ σκληρύνει ὃν θέλει
verses.transliteration: ara oun eleei hon thelei de sklērynei hon thelei
verses.literal: Therefore . . . [God] has mercy on whom He wants [to have mercy ] and He hardens whom He wants [ to harden ]

verses.original: οὖν Ἐρεῖς μοι οὖν Τί ἔτι μέμφεται γὰρ τίς ἀνθέστηκεν αὐτοῦ τῷ βουλήματι
verses.transliteration: oun Ereis moi oun Ti eti memphetai gar tis anthestēken autou tō boulēmati
verses.literal: - One of you will say to me Then why vvv does [God] still find fault For who can resist His - will

verses.original: μενοῦνγε τίς εἶ ὦ ἄνθρωπε σὺ ὁ ἀνταποκρινόμενος τῷ Θεῷ μὴ τὸ πλάσμα ἐρεῖ τῷ πλάσαντι Τί ἐποίησας με οὕτως
verses.transliteration: menounge tis ei ō anthrōpe sy ho antapokrinomenos tō Theō mē to plasma erei tō plasanti Ti epoiēsas me houtōs
verses.literal: But who are you O man - - to talk back - to God [Shall] what is formed say to Him who formed [it] Why did You make me like this

verses.original: ἢ οὐκ ὁ κεραμεὺς ἔχει ἐξουσίαν ποιῆσαι ἐκ τοῦ αὐτοῦ φυράματος τοῦ πηλοῦ ὃ σκεῦος μὲν εἰς τιμὴν δὲ ὃ εἰς ἀτιμίαν
verses.transliteration: ē ouk ho kerameus echei exousian poiēsai ek tou autou phyramatos tou pēlou ho skeuos men eis timēn de ho eis atimian
verses.literal: - {Does} not the potter have the right to make from the same lump - of clay one vessel - for special occasions and [another] for common use

verses.original: δὲ Εἰ ὁ Θεὸς θέλων ἐνδείξασθαι τὴν ὀργὴν καὶ γνωρίσαι αὐτοῦ τὸ δυνατὸν ἤνεγκεν ἐν πολλῇ μακροθυμίᾳ σκεύη ὀργῆς κατηρτισμένα εἰς ἀπώλειαν
verses.transliteration: de Ei ho Theos thelōn endeixasthai tēn orgēn kai gnōrisai autou to dynaton ēnenken en pollē makrothymia skeuē orgēs katērtismena eis apōleian
verses.literal: - What if - God intending to show [His] wrath and make His - power {known} bore with great patience [the] vessels of His wrath prepared for destruction

verses.original: καὶ ἵνα γνωρίσῃ τὸν πλοῦτον τῆς αὐτοῦ δόξης ἐπὶ σκεύη ἐλέους ἃ προητοίμασεν εἰς δόξαν
verses.transliteration: kai hina gnōrisē ton plouton tēs autou doxēs epi skeuē eleous ha proētoimasen eis doxan
verses.literal: [What if He did this] to make the riches of His glory {known} to [the] vessels of [His] mercy whom He prepared in advance for glory

verses.original: καὶ ἡμᾶς οὓς ἐκάλεσεν οὐ μόνον ἐξ Ἰουδαίων ἀλλὰ καὶ ἐξ ἐθνῶν
verses.transliteration: kai hēmas hous ekalesen ou monon ex Ioudaiōn alla kai ex ethnōn
verses.literal: including us whom He has called not only from [the] Jews but also from [the] Gentiles

verses.original: ὡς καὶ λέγει ἐν τῷ Ὡσηὲ Καλέσω μου λαόν τὸν οὐ μου λαόν καὶ ἠγαπημένην τὴν οὐκ ἠγαπημένην
verses.transliteration: hōs kai legei en tō Hōsēe Kalesō mou laon ton ou mou laon kai ēgapēmenēn tēn ouk ēgapēmenēn
verses.literal: As - He says in - Hosea I will call [them] My People who [are] not My people and [I will call her] [My] Beloved who [is] not [My] beloved

verses.original: Καὶ Ἔσται ἐν τῷ τόπῳ οὗ ἐρρέθη αὐτοῖς ὑμεῖς Οὐ μου λαός ἐκεῖ κληθήσονται Υἱοὶ ζῶντος Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: Kai Estai en tō topō hou errethē autois hymeis Ou mou laos ekei klēthēsontai Huioi zōntos Theou
verses.literal: and It will happen that in the very place where it was said to them You [are] not My people - they will be called sons of [the] living God

verses.original: δὲ Ἠσαΐας κράζει ὑπὲρ τοῦ Ἰσραήλ Ἐὰν ὁ ἀριθμὸς τῶν υἱῶν Ἰσραὴλ ᾖ ὡς ἡ ἄμμος τῆς θαλάσσης τὸ ὑπόλειμμα σωθήσεται
verses.transliteration: de Ēsaias krazei hyper tou Israēl Ean ho arithmos tōn huiōn Israēl ē hōs hē ammos tēs thalassēs to hypoleimma sōthēsetai
verses.literal: - Isaiah cries out concerning - Israel Though the number of the vvv Israelites is like the sand of the sea [only] the remnant will be saved

verses.original: γὰρ Κύριος ποιήσει λόγον ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς συντελῶν καὶ συντέμνων
verses.transliteration: gar Kyrios poiēsei logon epi tēs gēs syntelōn kai syntemnōn
verses.literal: For [the] Lord will carry out [His] sentence on the earth thoroughly and decisively

verses.original: Καὶ καθὼς Ἠσαΐας προείρηκεν Εἰ μὴ Κύριος Σαβαὼθ ἐγκατέλιπεν ἡμῖν σπέρμα ἂν ἐγενήθημεν ὡς Σόδομα καὶ ἂν ὡμοιώθημεν ὡς Γόμορρα
verses.transliteration: Kai kathōs Ēsaias proeirēken Ei mē Kyrios Sabaōth enkatelipen hēmin sperma an egenēthēmen hōs Sodoma kai an hōmoiōthēmen hōs Gomorra
verses.literal: - [It is] just as Isaiah foretold Unless . . . [the] Lord of Hosts had left us descendants vvv we would have become like Sodom - vvv we would have resembled . . . Gomorrah

verses.original: Τί οὖν ἐροῦμεν ὅτι ἔθνη τὰ μὴ διώκοντα δικαιοσύνην κατέλαβεν δικαιοσύνην δὲ δικαιοσύνην τὴν ἐκ πίστεως
verses.transliteration: Ti oun eroumen hoti ethnē ta mē diōkonta dikaiosynēn katelaben dikaiosynēn de dikaiosynēn tēn ek pisteōs
verses.literal: What then will we say That [the] Gentiles who vvv did not pursue righteousness have obtained [it] - a righteousness that [is] by faith

verses.original: δὲ Ἰσραὴλ διώκων νόμον δικαιοσύνης οὐκ ἔφθασεν εἰς νόμον
verses.transliteration: de Israēl diōkōn nomon dikaiosynēs ouk ephthasen eis nomon
verses.literal: but Israel who pursued a law of righteousness vvv has not attained vvv [it]

verses.original: διὰ τί ὅτι οὐκ ἐκ πίστεως ἀλλ’ ὡς ἐξ ἔργων προσέκοψαν τῷ τοῦ προσκόμματος λίθῳ
verses.transliteration: dia ti hoti ouk ek pisteōs all’ hōs ex ergōn prosekopsan tō tou proskommatos lithō
verses.literal: Why [not] . . . Because [their pursuit was] not by faith but as if [it were] by works They stumbled over the vvv stumbling stone

verses.original: καθὼς γέγραπται Ἰδοὺ τίθημι ἐν Σιὼν λίθον προσκόμματος καὶ πέτραν σκανδάλου καὶ ὁ πιστεύων ἐπ’ αὐτῷ οὐ καταισχυνθήσεται
verses.transliteration: kathōs gegraptai Idou tithēmi en Siōn lithon proskommatos kai petran skandalou kai ho pisteuōn ep’ autō ou kataischynthēsetai
verses.literal: as it is written See I lay in Zion a stone of stumbling and a rock of offense and the [one who] believes in Him vvv will never be put to shame
